steps.sub: Load via COPY, query the warehouse

steps.label: One-off question
steps.sub: Query spectrum / Athena directly, skip the load

code:
CREATE EXTERNAL SCHEMA spectrum
FROM DATA CATALOG
DATABASE 'northfield_catalog'
IAM_ROLE 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/northfield-redshift-copy-role'
CREATE EXTERNAL DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS;
caption: Reuses the same catalog database and the same COPY role.

code:
SELECT region, SUM(order_total) AS revenue
FROM spectrum.northfield_orders_curated
WHERE dt BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
caption: Reads the curated Parquet files in S3 directly. fact_orders is never touched.
